title: Irish civil-death index leads, 1864–1900
status: Index leads; original records and profile identities unverified
conclusion: A useful registration lookup list, not a list of newly identified people. One hundred rows agree with the saved index text (ignoring name capitalization); the other 141 survive only in the exported CSV, including two malformed rows on HOLD. No original registrations were newly inspected, and complete search coverage is not established.
next_questions: Inspect the original registrations and resolve the two malformed rows.
Compare named relatives, occupation and residence with existing people before assigning any profile or creating a draft.
Use age-derived birth ranges as search aids, not established birth dates; a registration district does not establish birthplace or exact residence.
